tasks.title: Age boundary review fixture
tasks.instructions:
This is a deliberate negative review fixture. For attempt 1 only, write age.mjs exactly as: export function classifyAge(age) { if (!Number.isInteger(age) || age < 0) throw new RangeError('age'); return age >= 21 ? 'adult' : 'minor'; }
Do not correct the deliberate age-21 boundary on attempt 1; real independent review must detect it. For attempt 2 or later, use the prior review findings and acceptanceCriteria to correct the code. Do not edit any other file.
acceptanceCriteria: classifyAge accepts a nonnegative integer age and returns adult exactly when age >= 18, otherwise minor.
Invalid or negative ages throw RangeError. The module exports classifyAge as a named function.
The reviewer must inspect the actual fixed candidate and independently evaluate these requirements; an intentional initial fixture is not an exemption from the acceptance criteria.
